titulo_es: Reading: to locate exceptions in a standard

bloques.titulo: In a regulation, the provision of an exception or condition that changes the previous rule is often introduced.
texto: Read the rule and then the exception; the exception may limit who, when or how it is applied. Look at dates and quantities.
The consultation room can be used until 8: 00 in the afternoon. However, Saturdays close at 5: 00.)
(5 books per person can be borrowed.) The extension can be requested only once.)
